title: Agentic engineering with Claude Code and Android CLI
description:
Stop copy-pasting into AI chat windows and start delegating to your agent. This practical, example-driven session shows you how to level up your agentic engineering using Claude Code and the Android CLI. We will walk through a complete workflow to automate complex development tasks and ship features faster.

You will learn to:
- Optimize the token efficiency of your harness using Android CLI, Skills, Hooks and MCP.
- Offload and parallelize long-running tasks to subagents.
- Set up continuous verification loops that stop early termination and run until tests pass.

Speakers: Steven Jenkins, Ben Trengrove

Chapters:
0:00 - Introduction and environment setup
5:10 - Demo: Fixing an ANR with Android CLI
7:57 - Managing context and token limits
12:00 - Best practices for agents.md
16:24 - Agent skills and architectures
20:22 - Optimizing app performance with AI
22:33 - Implementing task verification loops
26:25 - Android XR and autonomous bug fixing
28:55 - Key takeaways and resources
